title: wallet unwrapped
tagline: Like Spotify Wrapped, where you drop your address and get a slick summary of your degeneracy.

prizes.title: Best AI Experience with OpenSea MCP

description:
This is a Spotify Wrapped style app, but for your wallet. You enter your address, and behind the scenes we create WrappedCards that give you insight into aspects of your wallet trading, NFT holdings, and preferred assets. You can also write your own description for a wrapped card that you want to generate, and we use AI to try and make that for you!

The goal of this project was to have fun with leveraging the public nature of the blockchain and seeing how far we can push MCPs!
how_its_made: Behind the scenes, we rely on OpenSea's MCP and TheGraph's Hypergraph to query and store data. Essentially, we are building queries in natural language with an extensive system prompting guide to have the OpenSea MCP fetch the correct data and then our own LLM to perform some summary/insights. We then can publish our data to Hypergraph so we can publicly view other users' wrapped.
